_about: Shared sound effects for every series. Generate the files with: python scripts/make_sfx.py  (ElevenLabs sound effects → public/sfx/<id>.mp3). Episodes reference these by id.

boing.prompt: Cute cartoon boing spring sound, short and bouncy

pop.prompt: Soft cute bubble pop, single, clean

sparkle.prompt: Magical sparkle chime glissando, bright twinkly fairy dust, cute

whoosh.prompt: Quick soft swoosh of a text message being sent from a phone

message-in.prompt: Short pleasant two-note phone message notification ding

phone-buzz.prompt: Phone vibrating twice on a wooden table, buzz buzz

phone-ring.prompt: Gentle cartoon phone ringing tone, outgoing call ringback, two rings

typing.prompt: Fast tapping on a smartphone touch keyboard, soft clicks

clock-tick.prompt: Loud dramatic clock ticking, four ticks, comedic suspense

sad-trombone.prompt: Comedic sad trombone wah wah wah waaah

crickets.prompt: Awkward silence crickets chirping, comedic, short

record-scratch.prompt: Vinyl record scratch stop, comedic freeze

wobble.prompt: Cartoon wobble shake sound, boingy jelly wiggle

aww.prompt: Soft warm magical heart chime, gentle and sweet, single bell twinkle

dun-dun.prompt: Dramatic comedic orchestral sting dun dun duuun

phew.prompt: Soft cartoon deflating balloon relief sound, comedic sigh of relief
